run_pretrained_unet_inference: run a pretrained UNet model on subsampled MRI data to generate reconstructions for knee or brain scans
download_model: download a pretrained UNet state dict file from the fastMRI public model repository with a progress bar
run_unet_model: run a single batch of MRI data through a UNet model and return the reconstructed output with slice metadata
run_inference: run full inference on a dataset using a pretrained UNet model with automatic model download and reconstruction saving
review_run_inference: review the run_inference function to understand how it handles singlecoil and multicoil MRI challenges with SliceDataset
